ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have interest in conducting their own research should reach out directly to the instructor they would like to work with to initiate registration in this course. Upon agreeing to a project with a faculty member, the student will need to complete an Independent Study Form which can be found here: https://go.illinois.edu/IndependentStudy. Students must complete all sections of the form before it can be submitted for review by their participating instructor. Once the form has been reviewed and approved by the department, the student will receive further registration information from the College of Media Student Services Center.
